rationale: C05 is an unmistakable material drafting template and the directive expressly referenced by the child. The child closely reproduces C05's recital sequence, statutory machinery, national-interest finding, operative zero-quota determination, continuation of delegated authority to the Secretary of Agriculture with State concurrence, and immediate-publication clause, principally updating the statutory amendment, covered period, President, and prior-directive reference. C03 is a related earlier member of the same Cuban-sugar-quota drafting lineage but differs materially in its quota calculation and uses an initial rather than continued delegation. C22 is a distant third because it likewise modifies an agricultural import quota through a supplemental proclamation, but lacks the child’s distinctive statutory and operative structure.

shared_material.child_excerpt: section 408(b) (1) ... provides that the President shall determine ... the quota for Cuba ... in such amount or amounts as he shall find from time to time to be in the national interest
shared_material.parent_excerpt: section 408(b) (1) ... provides that the President shall determine ... the quota for Cuba ... in such amount or amounts as he shall find from time to time to be in the national interest
shared_material.explanation: The central statutory recital is reproduced with only the applicable period and amendment updated.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I find it to be in the national interest that the amount of the quotas for sugar and for liquid sugar for Cuba ... for the calendar year 1961 should be zero
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I find it to be in the national interest that the amount of the quotas for sugar and for liquid sugar for Cuba ... for the three-month period ending March 31, 1961, should be zero
shared_material.explanation: The child carries forward the same finding and zero-quota formulation while changing the covered period.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Do hereby continue the delegation to the Secretary of Agriculture ... such authority to be continued to be exercised with the concurrence of the Secretary of State.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Do hereby continue the delegation to the Secretary of Agriculture ... such authority to be continued to be exercised with the concurrence of the Secretary of State.
shared_material.explanation: This distinctive administrative mechanism is copied essentially verbatim.

shared_material.child_excerpt: This proclamation shall become effective immediately upon publication in the FEDERAL REGISTER.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: This proclamation shall become effective immediately upon publication in the FEDERAL REGISTER.
shared_material.explanation: The same effectiveness provision completes the parallel operative sequence.
